app.name: SHAKTI
app.tagline: Safety Assistance & Alert Technology for Help & Intervention
app.disclaimer: SHAKTI complements India's 112 (ERSS) and 181 Women Helpline. In immediate life-threatening danger, dial 112 directly.

welcome.title: Fast, discreet safety support that respects your autonomy.
welcome.subtitle: Designed to work alongside 112 and 181 without background tracking, coercive monitoring, or permanent location logs.

pillars.consentBody: Nothing is ever shared without your explicit per-contact permission. You see exactly what is shared and can revoke it anytime.
pillars.noTrackingBody: No passive background tracking, no 'track her' mode, and no permanent location history.
pillars.resilientBody: Designed for real-world network conditions with deterministic emergency paths and official helpline awareness.

step1.title: 1. You are always in control
step1.body: SHAKTI never tracks you in the background. Information is shared only when you actively trigger an alert or check-in, and it expires automatically. In life-threatening danger, always dial 112 (ERSS) or 181 directly.

step2.title: 2. Every permission is separate and revocable
step2.body: Location, notifications, microphone, camera, and data processing are controlled independently in the Consent Center. Every grant or revocation is recorded in a transparent history ledger.

step3.title: 3. Mutual consent for Trusted Contacts
step3.body: You can invite up to 5 trusted contacts. No one receives alerts until they explicitly accept your invitation link, and you can pause or remove any contact instantly.
step3.consentPromptTitle: Required to send alerts: Core Safety Data Processing
step3.consentPromptBody: To notify your trusted contacts when you trigger an SOS or check-in, SHAKTI needs your permission to process your account name, contact preferences, and active alert status. You can revoke this anytime in the Consent Center.
step3.consentCheckboxLabel: I understand and grant Core Safety Data Processing consent so SHAKTI can send alerts to my accepted contacts.
step3.consentAlreadyGranted: Core Safety Data Processing consent is active.

consents.title: Consent Center
consents.subtitle: Nothing is collected or shared without your explicit permission. You can grant or revoke any permission at any time, and every change is recorded in your append-only ledger.

consents.historySubtitle: Immutable audit trail of every permission grant and revocation on your account.

policy.title: Emergency Data Policy
policy.subtitle: Plain-language explanation of what $t(app.name) collects, who sees it, how long it is kept, and what happens when you delete your account.

section1Items.account: Account & Security Settings: Your phone number, display name, language preference, organization zone, and optional safety PIN features that change what is shown on screen.
section1Items.consents: Consent Ledger: Append-only record of permissions you grant or revoke (data processing, location, notifications, microphone, camera).
section1Items.contacts: Trusted Circle: Names, phone numbers, priority order, and sharing permissions of up to 5 trusted contacts you choose to add.
section1Items.incidents: Active Emergency Alerts (SOS): Incident timestamps, status transitions, notifications sent, and—only while an alert is open AND Location consent is granted—temporary GPS location samples.
section1Items.journeys: Safe Journey Timers: Start/end times and an optional short note (up to 100 characters). Safe Journeys never collect or share your location.
section1Items.reportsPulses: Community Reports & Weekly Pulses: ~100 m rounded grid coordinates for safety reports and 1–5 weekly safety scores. When submitted anonymously, no user ID and only the date (YYYY-MM-DD) are stored.

policy.section2Title: 2. Who Can See Your Data — and Under Which Consent

section2Items.contacts: Trusted Contacts: Notified only when your Data Processing consent is active, the contact has accepted your invitation, and you enabled their specific permission (SOS alerts, check-in notices, or live location). Live location requires both Location consent and the contact's live-location permission.
section2Items.responders: Campus / Community Responders: When an SOS alert becomes ACTIVE (and Data Processing consent is granted), on-duty responders in your organization zone see your first name, emergency category, and latest location (only if Location consent is granted). Your phone number is hidden until a responder acknowledges the alert. Responders never see your consent ledger or your other trusted contacts.
section2Items.admins: Administrators: View only aggregated impact metrics (with a minimum sample size of 5), responder duty rosters, access audit logs, and community report moderation queues.
section2Items.public: Other Users: See only k-anonymized ~100 m safety-layer grid cells that have at least 5 reports—never individual reports, notes, or identities.

policy.section3Title: 3. How Long Each Item Is Kept (Retention Schedule)

section3Items.locations: Location Samples (`location_samples`): Automatically purged after 7 days (configurable via `LOCATION_RETENTION_DAYS`).
section3Items.incidentTokens: Emergency Magic-Link Tokens (`contact_incident_tokens`): Stop working as soon as the incident closes or expires, and rows are purged 7 days after expiry.
section3Items.invitations: Contact Invitation Tokens (`contact_invitations`): Purged 30 days after expiry.
section3Items.journeyNotes: Safe Journey Notes (`journeys.note`): Free-text notes are automatically cleared to NULL 7 days after the journey ends.
section3Items.otpAndOutbox: OTP Codes & Dev Outbox (`otp_codes`, `sent_messages`): Expired OTP codes are purged on schedule; development outbox messages are purged after 7 days.

policy.section4Title: 4. What Happens When You Revoke Consent or Delete Your Account

section4Items.revoke: Revoking Consent: Takes effect immediately on the next check. Revoking Location consent stops any new location capture and hides location from contacts and responders. Revoking Data Processing consent stops contact/responder dispatch and clears the local emergency contact cache.
section4Items.delete: Deleting Your Account (`DELETE /api/me`): Requires a fresh 6-digit OTP code and typing DELETE (and is unavailable while an incident is open). In a single database transaction, $t(app.name) permanently deletes your user profile, phone number, PIN hashes, consent ledger, trusted contacts, invitations, magic-link tokens, location samples, walk timers, and dev outbox messages, and clears all local device caches. Past incident timestamps and status counts are anonymized (`user_id = 'deleted_user'`, notes and recipient references scrubbed) so aggregate safety metrics remain accurate without any link to you.

section5Items.noBackgroundTracking: Never tracks your location in the background, during a Safe Journey walk timer, or after an alert closes.
section5Items.noGuaranteedPolice: Never replaces 112 (ERSS) or 181 (Women Helpline), and never claims guaranteed police arrival or fake response times.
section5Items.noSilentSharing: Never shares your data with anyone without your explicit, revocable consent.

section6Items.localOnly: Local Storage: Contacts, settings, and device cancel PIN hashes in Guest Mode are saved only in this browser's IndexedDB and localStorage. They are never sent to the server and cannot be recovered if browser data is erased or when using private browsing.
section6Items.guestSos: Guest SOS & SMS: In Guest Mode, triggering SOS makes no server API calls. It launches your phone's SMS app to message your saved contacts, and location is included only if you already granted device permission. Guest SOS cannot escalate silently.
section6Items.duressRequiresAccount: Duress Needs an Account: The silent duress PIN is disabled in Guest Mode because silent server escalation requires a verified server-side account.

section7Items.noTracking: No Click or Purchase Tracking: SHAKTI does not track which links you click, what websites you visit, or what items you buy.
section7Items.noPurchaseData: No Purchase Data Stored: SHAKTI does not sell items, does not process payments, and stores zero checkout, cart, or purchase records.
section7Items.outboundLinks: Outbound Links Leave the App: Product or resource links point to third-party websites outside SHAKTI. Third-party sites have their own terms and privacy practices.
section7Items.notEndorsements: Informational Only, Not Endorsements: Tools listed in the guide are generic suggestions for personal safety. Listing does not constitute an endorsement, warranty, or guarantee of safety.
